answer_text: Yes, by its own account. FIFA says a criminal cyberattack gave someone unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information. It has not said how many people are affected or when it happened.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Did the Handsome Boy Hacking Club hack FIFA?
what_would_settle_it: So far only the group says it did. FIFA, law enforcement or a credible independent analysis naming who carried out the attack would settle it.

question_text: Were FIFA fans or ticket holders affected?
what_would_settle_it: FIFA has not said. FIFA saying whose personal information was accessed, or writing to the people affected, would settle it.

question_text: How did the attackers get into FIFA's systems?
answer_text: Not confirmed. A FIFA source told The Athletic that the attackers impersonated FIFA staff rather than exploiting a technical failure, but FIFA has said nothing about this publicly.
label: Reported

question_text: How much FIFA data was taken?
answer_text: Not established. The group claims more than 12 GB; a person familiar with the matter told Reuters it was less than 0.1 percent of FIFA's data. FIFA itself has given no figure.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: FIFA saying what was taken and how much.
